payout_quote: For a limited time, any current CEFCU member in good standing and non-member Friend can both receive up to $25 via direct deposit to their CEFCU Savings account when the Member refers the Friend to CEFCU, where the Friend opens a qualifying new CEFCU account and submits an Official Referral Certificate within five business days of account opening.
steps: Be a current CEFCU member in good standing
Fill out the Official Referral Certificate web form (or complete the Referred By section of the certificate) and provide it to your friend

Friend qualifies for CEFCU membership, opens a regular Savings account with at least $1 on or before 12/31/26, opens a qualifying CEFCU account at the same time, and submits the certificate within five business days
You and your friend each receive $25 via direct deposit to your CEFCU Savings accounts (for qualifying accounts: Checking, Vehicle Loan, or Credit Card; $10 for Personal Loan, HSA, or youth savings)
catches: Per-referral payout: $25 for qualifying Checking, Vehicle Loan, or Credit Card; $10 for Personal Loan, Health Savings Account, or youth savings
Cap: limit of 3 Referral Bonuses paid to a Member, or $75, whichever is greater, per calendar year
Friend must open a regular Savings account with at least $1 on or before 12/31/26
Official Referral Certificate must be submitted within five business days of account opening
Only one Referral Bonus per new Friend; bonuses deposited 4-6 weeks after the friend's account opening
Excludes Money Market, Club Accounts, Hybrid HELOCs, Home Loans, UTMA, Rep Payee, Certificates
Employees/volunteers of CEFCU, their immediate families, and household members are not eligible
biggest_catch: $25 per referral ($10 for small products) — and there's a paperwork race: the Official Referral Certificate must be filed within five business days of your friend's account opening.
eligibility: Current CEFCU members in good standing; referred friends must be new, non-member individuals who qualify for membership
timing: Bonuses deposited 4-6 weeks after the friend's account opening; savings must open by 12/31/26
